authority: Current-root source and native-query catalogue coverage only. Script presence and literal invocation edges do not prove execution, cacheability, semantic equivalence, qualification or performance.
query: query { packages { items { name tasks { items { fullName command } } } } }
rowSemantics: Each row is a named script entrypoint outside the requested configured graph projection. A directConfiguredCallers edge exists only when the complete parent command is exactly bun run <script> in the same workspace. It is not a semantic-equivalence, deduplication or qualification grant. Unlisted dynamic and composite callers are not inferred absent. An explicit currentSemanticReview and finalDisposition on a row overrides rowDefaults; these source-only whole-mutator decisions grant no qualification to the separate read-only counterpart.
digestSemantics: literalCommandSha256 hashes UTF-8 command text only. Existing census commandDigest hashes the entire workspace script map and remains unchanged.
remainingObligations: Review every script-only entrypoint role, dynamic/composite caller and eligible pure boundary before final disposition.
Reconcile direct and nested invocation with actual executions; query commands and graph nodes are not successful execution identities.
Complete all 2232 pending configured-computation reviews, current feature decisions, tuple qualifications and rollout/observation requirements.

captureRefusal.reason: Initial unnecessary field selection exceeded the one-MiB stdout bound.
captureRefusal.repair: Select only package name, task fullName and command; retain the same byte and time bounds.

rawRetention: Owner-only private native stdout/stderr and the collector retained through both goal closeouts; no configured expiry or offsite backup claim. Raw output is not committed.
